fields.description: Issue includes commentary on Miami’s dependence on tourism and criticism of rent increases and landlord practices as the season and a Legion convention approach; reprints a Washington political column discussing Louis McHenry Howe defending New Deal subsistence homestead ideas and mentions Franklin D. Roosevelt and Eleanor Roosevelt; contains local notebook items and opinion pieces, radio program schedules, and extensive horse-racing tips and advertisements for Miami-area businesses and nightlife venues.
